list.title: Vouchers
list.description: Voucher products and their Pools. Available counts only Vouchers that can still be sold.
list.empty: No Voucher products yet. Mark a variant as a Voucher product on its page.

import.title: Import Vouchers
import.hint: Creates a Voucher batch from a CSV file with a code column and optional pin, valid_from and valid_until columns. The file's codes are never shown.
import.redemptionHint: Sent to customers with their codes. Starts as the latest batch's.
import.noRows: The file has no rows to import.
import.tooManyRows: The file has {{rows}} rows; at most {{max}} can be imported at once.

problems.invalid_csv_row: Line {{line}}: the row is not valid CSV or has a different number of columns than the header
problems.no_rows: The file has no Voucher rows
problems.missing_code_column: Line {{line}}: the header must have a "code" column
problems.too_many_rows: The file has more than {{max}} Vouchers; split it into several batches
problems.invalid_date: Line {{line}}: {{column}} must be a date as YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY
problems.code_repeated_in_file: Line {{line}}: the code repeats an earlier line of the file
problems.code_already_stored: Line {{line}}: the code is already stored

widget.title: Voucher product
widget.notMarked: This variant does not deliver Vouchers. Mark it to sell Vouchers bought from its Partner.
widget.markHint: Each unit sold delivers one Voucher of this Face value. It cannot be changed once Vouchers are imported.
widget.locked: Has Vouchers, so the Face value and currency can no longer change.
widget.loadFailed: Could not load the Voucher product. Reload the page to try again.
